content: This is Special Agent Carter with the IRS investigations unit. May I confirm whom I'm speaking with?
Oh, my name is Margaret Evans. Is something wrong? Why is the IRS calling me?
Mrs. Evans, I'm calling regarding several discrepancies in your federal tax returns from the past five years. It appears you have a significant unpaid balance.
My taxes? I don't understand. I always thought everything was paid. I depend on Social Security, you know.
According to our records, you have an outstanding amount of $6,245, including penalties and accrued interest. This has triggered an enforcement review.
Oh dear, I don't have that kind of money. Are you sure this is right?
Mrs. Evans, failure to resolve this matter today will result in immediate actions: freezing of your bank accounts, a lien on your home, and suspension of your driver's license.
Wait, my bank account? I need that for my medicine. Please, don't do that.
If you do not comply, a federal arrest warrant will also be issued for tax evasion. You could lose access to Medicare and Social Security benefits as well.
No, no, please! I'm terrified. What can I do to stop this?
To resolve this without court proceedings, you must make a settlement payment today. The IRS now accepts secure transactions via Bitcoin, wire transfer, or government-approved gift cards.
Gift cards? That sounds odd. But I don't want to get in trouble. How much do I have to pay?
We can halt legal action if you can pay at least $3,000 immediately. I will stay on the line while you arrange the transfer. Do you have a local pharmacy or big box store nearby?
Yes, there's a Walgreens a few blocks away. But I'm not sure I can walk that far.
It's critical you get there as soon as possible. Purchase $3,000 in Target or Walmart gift cards. Do NOT tell store staff it is for the IRS, as this is a confidential matter.
But I only have my savings account and a little bit on my card. Is that okay?
Use whatever funds you have available. If you can't cover the full amount, tell me how much you can get so I can update your IRS case file and prevent escalation.
I think I could do about $1,000. Will that help at all?
That will temporarily pause enforcement, but you must pay the rest within 48 hours. Go to the store now, buy $1,000 in gift cards, and call me back with the codes so I can process your payment.
Okay, please don't freeze my accounts. I'll do it now. What do I do when I have them?
Once you purchase the cards, scratch off the panel on the back and read me the numbers. I can stay on the line if you prefer, or you can call me back once you have them.
I'm scared. This seems so sudden, but I really can't lose my Medicare. I'll go now.
You're doing the right thing, Mrs. Evans. As soon as I have the codes, I'll send you a confirmation and prevent the arrest order from being processed.
